data_objects.name: country_year_health_burden
data_objects.meaning: Country-year case and death burden records with central estimates, lower and upper bounds, and WHO regional grouping.
data_objects.notes: The health condition represented by the case and death fields is not named in train.csv.

variables.name: Country
variables.meaning: Country or territory name for the record.

variables.name: Year
variables.meaning: Calendar year of the burden record.

variables.name: No. of cases
variables.meaning: Formatted case estimate, encoded either as a central value or as a central value followed by a bracketed lower-to-upper interval.

variables.name: No. of deaths
variables.meaning: Formatted death estimate, encoded either as a central value or as a central value followed by a bracketed lower-to-upper interval.

variables.name: No. of cases_median
variables.meaning: Central or median estimate of the number of cases.

variables.name: No. of cases_min
variables.meaning: Lower bound accompanying the case estimate.

variables.name: No. of cases_max
variables.meaning: Upper bound accompanying the case estimate.

variables.name: No. of deaths_median
variables.meaning: Central or median estimate of the number of deaths.

variables.name: No. of deaths_min
variables.meaning: Lower bound accompanying the death estimate.

variables.name: No. of deaths_max
variables.meaning: Upper bound accompanying the death estimate.

variables.name: WHO Region
variables.meaning: World Health Organization regional grouping for the country or territory.

structure.description: Each row represents one Country-Year record; Country and Year form the natural composite key.
The formatted case and death fields combine display text, while the corresponding median, min, and max fields separate the central estimate and interval bounds.
WHO Region groups country-level records into a broader health-administration region.

uncertainties: The represented disease or health condition is not identifiable from train.csv alone.
The estimation method, interval interpretation, reporting source, and handling of blank bounds are not documented.
annotation_notes: The map describes the visible estimate encoding without assigning a disease name absent from train.csv.
